title: Interactive Environment - Florida
description: A small interactive environment crafted in Unity based on a painting by Alfred Hair
fullDescription: This project is an interactive environment made in Unity based on a painting by Alfred Hair. The scene is set in Florida, featuring a wetlands area inspired by the Everglades and a calm beach inspired by the Florida Keys.
As part of the assignment, I modeled 3 different assets in Maya: a crocodile, an openable cooler box, and a flashlight.
